From your Mexico City apartment window, you see harmony prevail in a thriving metropolis. Streets brim with cooperative residents who respect each other. Markets overflow with fresh produce, featuring local co-ops alongside larger markets offering diverse goods. A credit system supports community needs without profit extraction.

Community is the city's heart, fostering social harmony and allowing people to thrive despite differences or uncertainties. Morning light dances across skyscrapers, symbolizing balance between human ingenuity and natural beauty. Despite imperfections, it showcases what can happen when people choose cooperation over conflict, sustainability over greed—resulting in clean air, plentiful water, and vibrant streets.
